65:   # Filament uses the WASM variable (not EMSCRIPTEN) to identify web builds.
66:   # Without this, it falls into the LINUX path and tries to compile with
67:   # futex, X11, Vulkan, etc.
68:   if(MUJOCO_USE_FILAMENT)

72:   # Automatically generate host tool imports for Filament cross-compilation.
73:   # When WASM is true, Filament hardcodes the path to:
74:   #   ${FILAMENT}/${IMPORT_EXECUTABLES_DIR}/ImportExecutables-Release.cmake
75:   # So we write our file with that exact name and set IMPORT_EXECUTABLES_DIR
76:   # to point at CMAKE_BINARY_DIR (which is ../../ relative to filament-src).
77:   set(MUJOCO_NATIVE_BUILD_DIR "${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/build-host" CACHE PATH "Path to native build directory containing host tools")
78:   find_program(MATC_EXE matc PATHS "${MUJOCO_NATIVE_BUILD_DIR}/bin" NO_DEFAULT_PATH)
79:   find_program(RESGEN_EXE resgen PATHS "${MUJOCO_NATIVE_BUILD_DIR}/bin" NO_DEFAULT_PATH)
80:   find_program(CMGEN_EXE cmgen PATHS "${MUJOCO_NATIVE_BUILD_DIR}/bin" NO_DEFAULT_PATH)
81: 
82:   if(MATC_EXE AND RESGEN_EXE AND CMGEN_EXE)
83:     message(STATUS "Found host tools in ${MUJOCO_NATIVE_BUILD_DIR}/bin")
84:     set(IMPORT_EXECUTABLES_FILE "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/ImportExecutables-Release.cmake")
85:     file(WRITE "${IMPORT_EXECUTABLES_FILE}"
86:       "add_executable(matc IMPORTED)\n"
87:       "set_property(TARGET matc PROPERTY IMPORTED_LOCATION \"${MATC_EXE}\")\n"
88:       "add_executable(resgen IMPORTED)\n"
89:       "set_property(TARGET resgen PROPERTY IMPORTED_LOCATION \"${RESGEN_EXE}\")\n"
90:       "add_executable(cmgen IMPORTED)\n"
91:       "set_property(TARGET cmgen PROPERTY IMPORTED_LOCATION \"${CMGEN_EXE}\")\n"
92:     )
93:     # Filament's WASM path resolves: ${FILAMENT}/${IMPORT_EXECUTABLES_DIR}/ImportExecutables-Release.cmake
94:     # FILAMENT = _deps/filament-src, so ../../ resolves to CMAKE_BINARY_DIR.
95:     set(IMPORT_EXECUTABLES_DIR "../../" CACHE PATH "" FORCE)
96:   else()
97:     message(WARNING "Host tools (matc, resgen, cmgen) not found in ${MUJOCO_NATIVE_BUILD_DIR}/bin. WASM build of Studio might fail.")
98:   endif()
99: endif()

101: if(APPLE AND (MUJOCO_BUILD_EXAMPLES OR MUJOCO_BUILD_SIMULATE OR MUJOCO_USE_FILAMENT))

92: def tokenize_quoted_substr(input_string, quote_char, placeholders=None):
93:   """Replace quoted substrings with random text placeholders with no spaces."""
94:   # Matches quote characters not proceded with a backslash.
95:   pattern = re.compile(r'(?<!\\)' + quote_char)
96:   quote_positions = [m.start() for m in pattern.finditer(input_string)]
97:   if len(quote_positions) % 2:
98:     raise ValueError(f'unbalanced quotes {quote_char}...{quote_char}')
99: 
100:   output_string = ''
101:   placeholders = placeholders if placeholders is not None else dict()
102:   prev_end = -1
103:   for start, end in start_and_end(quote_positions):
104:     output_string += input_string[prev_end + 1 : start]
105:     while True:
106:       placeholder = ''.join(random.choices(string.ascii_lowercase, k=5))
107:       if placeholder not in input_string and placeholder not in output_string:
108:         break
109:     output_string += placeholder
110:     placeholders[placeholder] = input_string[start + 1 : end]
111:     prev_end = end
112:   output_string += input_string[prev_end + 1 :]
113: 
114:   return output_string, placeholders
